hint: The place is also called The Vision, for Laban's prayer that God watch between them once they part.

notes.text: [[flag]] The Hebrew is Miṣpâ, Mizpah, heard in *ṣāpâ*, *he watched*; the Greek translates the name.
The printed page capitalises the article that opens the name, where the digital module has lower-case ἡ; the transcription follows the page.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.
